independent_digest_reconstruction.method: Independent standard-library IEEE binary32-to-BF16 bit derivation, TP8 catalogue shapes, finite-period algebra; both remote output digests match.

scope: Four chips, 1,028 real TP8 shard shapes per chip, 31,448,474,464 synthetic source bytes; two repetitions over the same generated arrays, not live model weights or independent experiment repeats.
timer_boundaries: Kernel-ready wall includes Python enqueue and waits for all 4,112 outputs. The following ndarray conversion/list materialization and readback is separately timed and required for host consumption. The excluded compile interval includes both generators and reducers together, not checksum-only compile cost. Analytic comparison and output-digest hashing occur after the readback timer.

integrity.algorithm: uint32 modular sum of BF16 uint16 words plus XOR
integrity.single_bit_scope: For faithfully preserved uint16 input bits, one bit changes modular sum by +/-2^k with k<16, hence cannot preserve it. Native evidence covers finite integer patterns only, not all NaN/special-value preservation behavior.
integrity.digest_caveat: SHA256 of the 32,896 output bytes authenticates this retained weak-checksum vector; it does not turn the reduction into SHA256 of source weights.

cleanup_limit: Artifact records actor-kill/placement-group-removal requests and no tmpfs creation, not an independently observed empty cluster resource inventory.
